:::{#def-variance}
#### Variance

The **variance** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$ with $\E{X^2} < \infty$ is the [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of the squared [deviation from the mean](#def-deviation-pop-mean)
[@wikipedia_variance]; that is:

$$\Var{X} \eqdef \E{[\devn(X)]^2}$$

:::
